metadata.notes: FR-05 alert latency (< 30s) requires a dedicated integration test against the Alert Evaluator service — cannot be fully validated by UI automation alone. Push notification delivery tests require a physical device or Firebase Test Lab.

test_cases.title: Add a valid ticker to an empty watchlist

given: User is logged in as 'alex@tradeeasy.com'
User's watchlist is empty
User navigates to the AAPL ticker detail screen
then: A success toast 'AAPL added to your watchlist' appears within 2 seconds
The 'Add to Watchlist' button is replaced with an 'In Watchlist' indicator
Navigating to the Watchlist tab shows AAPL as the first (and only) row

preconditions: User account exists with email 'alex@tradeeasy.com' and password 'Demo1234!'
AAPL is a valid US equity ticker in the system
test_cases.automation_notes: Assert toast text exactly; assert button state change; assert watchlist row count = 1

test_cases.title: Watchlist displays live price during market hours

given: User has AAPL and MSFT on their watchlist
Current time is 10:30 AM ET on a trading day
AAPL last price is $192.50, change is +1.2%
then: AAPL row shows '$192.50' as last price
AAPL row shows '+1.20%' as intraday change in green text
Price updates again within 15 seconds without user interaction

preconditions: AAPL and MSFT are on user's watchlist
Market is open (09:30–16:00 ET Mon–Fri)
test_cases.automation_notes: Use mock quote feed in CI; real Polygon feed for staging integration tests. Assert price refresh via DOM mutation observer within 15000ms.

test_cases.title: Watchlist shows Market Closed label outside trading hours

given: User has AAPL on their watchlist
Current time is 8:00 PM ET on a weekday (market closed)
then: AAPL row displays previous close price
A 'Market Closed' label is visible on each row or as a banner

preconditions: AAPL is on user's watchlist
test_cases.automation_notes: Mock system time in test environment to simulate market closed state

test_cases.title: Create a valid price-above alert

given: User is logged in
AAPL current price is $192.50
User has 0 active alerts
when: User opens the AAPL ticker detail screen
then: A success message 'Alert set for AAPL at $200.00' is displayed
Navigating to the Alerts tab shows one active alert: AAPL | Above | $200.00 | Push
Alert count in user profile shows 1 of 20 used

preconditions: User is authenticated
AAPL current price is below $200.00

test_cases.title: Create a valid price-below alert

given: User is logged in
AAPL current price is $192.50
User has 0 active alerts
when: User enters target price '180.00', direction 'Below', channel 'Email'
then: Success toast shown
Alert appears in Alerts tab as: AAPL | Below | $180.00 | Email

preconditions: User is authenticated
AAPL current price is above $180.00

test_cases.title: Alert creation blocked when target price already met

given: User is logged in
AAPL current price is $192.50
when: User opens Set Alert for AAPL
then: An inline validation error is shown: 'AAPL is already below $190.00'
The alert is NOT created
No entry appears in the Alerts tab

preconditions: AAPL current price is $192.50 (above $190.00, so a 'below $190' alert is already met)
test_cases.automation_notes: Verify the exact error message text. Verify alert is not in DB via API assertion.

test_cases.title: Alert creation blocked at 20-alert cap

given: User is logged in
User already has 20 active alerts across various tickers
when: User opens Set Alert for MSFT
then: Creation is blocked with message: 'You've reached the 20-alert limit. Delete an alert to add a new one.'
The Alerts tab still shows exactly 20 alerts
No new alert is created in the database

preconditions: User has exactly 20 active alerts
test_cases.automation_notes: Seed 20 active alerts via API setup before test. Assert DB count = 20 after attempt.

test_cases.title: Alert creation with negative target price

given: User is on the Set Alert screen for AAPL
then: An inline validation error is shown: 'Target price must be greater than $0.00'
The alert is not created

test_cases.title: Alert creation with non-numeric target price

given: User is on the Set Alert screen for AAPL
then: An inline validation error is shown: 'Please enter a valid price'
The alert is not created

test_cases.automation_notes: Check that numeric keyboard is enforced on mobile; this test is primarily for web.

test_cases.title: Alert creation with zero target price

given: User is on the Set Alert screen for AAPL
then: An inline validation error is shown: 'Target price must be greater than $0.00'
The alert is not created

test_cases.title: Alert creation with maximum possible price

given: User is on the Set Alert screen for AAPL
AAPL current price is $192.50
then: Alert is created successfully (the value is technically valid even if implausible)
Alert appears in Alerts tab with target price '$99,999,999.9999'

test_cases.automation_notes: Verify NUMERIC(12,4) column does not overflow — max value is 99,999,999.9999

test_cases.title: Push notification delivered within 30 seconds of price crossing

given: User has an active alert: AAPL above $200.00
AAPL current price is $199.50
when: A trade for AAPL executes at $200.10 during market hours (10:00 AM ET)
then: User receives a push notification within 30 seconds
Notification text reads: 'AAPL reached your target of $200.00 — now at $200.10'
Alert status in the Alerts tab changes to 'Triggered'
Alert moves from Active to History tab

preconditions: User has push notifications enabled on device
Alert Evaluator service is running
test_cases.automation_notes: Requires integration test with mock Quote Feed emitting the trigger price. Use Firebase Test Lab or stub FCM. Assert notification delivery timestamp delta < 30000ms.

test_cases.title: Email fallback sent when push notification fails

given: User has an active push alert: AAPL above $200.00
FCM is configured to return a delivery failure for this device token
then: Push notification attempt is made (and fails)
Within 5 minutes of the trigger, a fallback email is sent to 'alex@tradeeasy.com'
Email subject contains 'AAPL' and '$200.00'
alert_notifications table has two rows: push (failed) and email (sent)

preconditions: FCM delivery failure simulated via test configuration or mock
test_cases.automation_notes: Stub FCM client to return 'NotRegistered' error. Assert SendGrid mock received email call within 300000ms.

test_cases.title: Notification tap navigates to ticker detail with pre-filled order

given: User received a push notification for AAPL alert at $200.00
App is in background
then: App opens to AAPL ticker detail screen
Order ticket is visible and pre-filled with: side = Buy, type = Market, ticker = AAPL

preconditions: Push notification has been received on device
test_cases.automation_notes: Test deep link routing in isolation. Verify order form pre-population via element assertions.

test_cases.title: Alert does not trigger outside market hours

given: User has an active alert: AAPL above $200.00
Current time is 6:00 PM ET (market closed)
when: A trade for AAPL executes at $200.10 in after-hours trading
then: No push notification is sent
Alert status remains 'Active'
No triggered_at timestamp is written to the database

preconditions: Alert Evaluator is configured to suppress triggers outside 09:30–16:00 ET
test_cases.automation_notes: Mock system time to after-hours. Emit trigger price into quote feed. Assert no notification row inserted after 35s wait.

test_cases.title: Alert does not fire twice for the same price crossing

given: User has an active alert: AAPL above $200.00
when: AAPL price dips below $200.00 at 10:01 AM
AAPL price crosses $200.00 again at 10:02 AM
then: Only one push notification is ever sent for this alert
After the first trigger, alert status is 'Triggered' and it does not re-arm automatically

test_cases.automation_notes: Emit three price events through mock quote feed. Assert alert_notifications count = 1 and price_alerts.status = 'triggered'.

test_cases.title: Delete an active alert

given: User has 3 active alerts including one for MSFT above $400.00
when: User swipes left on the MSFT alert row
then: MSFT alert row is removed immediately
Alerts tab now shows 2 alerts
MSFT alert no longer appears after refreshing the Alerts tab
Alert count shows 2 of 20 used

preconditions: User has 3 active alerts

test_cases.title: Re-arm a triggered alert

given: User has a triggered alert for AAPL above $200.00 in their history
User has 5 active alerts (below the 20-alert cap)
when: User opens the Alerts History tab
User taps 'Re-arm' on the AAPL alert
then: Alert moves back to the Active tab with status 'Active'
Target price remains $200.00 and direction remains 'Above'
Active alert count increases by 1

preconditions: User has a triggered alert in history
Active alert count is below 20
test_cases.automation_notes: Assert triggered_at is reset to null and status = 'active' in DB.

test_cases.title: Re-arm blocked when at 20-alert cap

given: User has a triggered alert for AAPL in history
User already has 20 active alerts
when: User taps 'Re-arm' on the AAPL alert
then: Re-arm is blocked
A message is shown: 'You've reached the 20-alert limit. Delete an alert to add a new one.'
The alert remains in History with status 'Triggered'

preconditions: User has 20 active alerts and at least 1 triggered alert

test_cases.title: Remove a watchlist ticker also deletes its alerts

given: User has AAPL on their watchlist
User has 2 active alerts for AAPL (above $200, below $170)
when: User swipes left on AAPL in the watchlist and taps 'Remove'
then: AAPL is removed from the watchlist
A toast is shown: 'AAPL removed from watchlist. 2 alerts deleted.'
Navigating to the Alerts tab shows 0 AAPL alerts
Alert count decreases by 2

preconditions: AAPL on watchlist with 2 active alerts
test_cases.automation_notes: Verify cascade delete in DB: price_alerts where ticker='AAPL' and user_id=X count = 0.

test_cases.title: Add a duplicate ticker to the watchlist

given: User already has AAPL on their watchlist
when: User navigates to the AAPL ticker detail screen
then: The button shows 'In Watchlist' (not 'Add to Watchlist')
No duplicate row appears in the watchlist
Watchlist count remains unchanged

preconditions: AAPL already in user's watchlist
test_cases.automation_notes: Assert watchlist_items count for user remains the same before and after.

test_cases.title: Add an invalid ticker to the watchlist

given: User searches for ticker 'ZZZZZ' which does not exist
then: No ticker result is displayed
An inline message 'Ticker not found' is shown
There is no 'Add to Watchlist' button visible

test_cases.title: Watchlist order persists across sessions

given: User has AAPL, MSFT, GOOG on their watchlist in that order
when: User drags GOOG to the top of the list
then: Watchlist shows GOOG, AAPL, MSFT in that order

preconditions: User has 3 watchlist items
test_cases.automation_notes: Assert sort_order values in DB after PATCH /api/watchlist/reorder.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot access watchlist API

given: No authentication token is included in the request
when: A GET request is made to /api/watchlist
then: The API returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
The response body contains an error code 'UNAUTHORIZED'
No watchlist data is returned

test_cases.automation_notes: API-level test. Assert status code 401 and no data payload.

test_cases.title: User cannot access another user's alerts

given: User A has an alert with id 'alert-user-a-001'
User B is logged in with a valid JWT
then: The API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden
Alert 'alert-user-a-001' still exists and belongs to User A

preconditions: Two user accounts exist: User A and User B
User A has an active alert
test_cases.automation_notes: Assert HTTP 403 and verify DB record unchanged.

test_cases.title: Watchlist empty state shown when no items

given: User has a new account with no watchlist items
then: An empty state screen is displayed
A call to action 'Search for a ticker to add' is visible and tappable
Tapping the call to action navigates to the Search screen

preconditions: User has zero watchlist items

test_cases.title: Alert history shows triggered alerts up to 90 days

given: User has a triggered alert from 89 days ago and one from 91 days ago
when: User opens the Alerts History tab
then: The 89-day-old alert is visible
The 91-day-old alert is NOT visible (purged per NFR-07)

preconditions: Two triggered alerts seeded: one 89 days old, one 91 days old
test_cases.automation_notes: Seed alerts with created_at timestamps. Run purge job before asserting.

test_cases.title: Alert creation rejected when target price is current price exactly

given: AAPL current price is exactly $192.50
when: User attempts to create an alert for AAPL above $192.50
then: Alert creation is rejected with message 'AAPL is already at or above $192.50'

preconditions: AAPL price is exactly $192.50 (boundary condition)
test_cases.automation_notes: Mock quote feed to return exact boundary price.
